findings.title: Cadence clamp 60s ceiling prevents customer-wall freeze
findings.evidence: _clampCadence applied at both intervalMsWhenConnected + intervalMsWhenDisconnected entry points. A runtime misconfig like FK_CATALOG_OSS_FALLBACK_CONNECTED_INTERVAL_MS=999999999 now resolves to 60_000ms instead of 11.5 days. SYNC-2 8s budget preserved.
findings.status: ALREADY-HEAL-APPLIED via Wave 3c KDS-ADV3C-08 in c2613cab0+downstream. No further action.

findings.title: Cadence clamp applied only on start() — not on runtime config refresh
findings.evidence: OssSyncService._runtimeConfig() (lines 117-136) reads window.foodkingConfig.ossFallbackPolling at start() only (line 61). If a CDN-pushed config or admin live-edit mutates window.foodkingConfig.ossFallbackPolling.intervalMsWhenConnected post-start, the new value is NOT clamped — _opts values remain whatever start() captured. RISK: if start() never re-runs (component does not unmount/remount across long-running TV-wall sessions), a corrupted in-flight config goes unenforced.
findings.rationale_already_heal_or_new: NET-NEW gap — Wave 3c clamp heal protects boot path but does not protect runtime refresh path. Was not surfaced in round-1.
findings.heal_recommendation: Either (a) document that ossFallbackPolling config is set-once-per-mount and runtime mutation is unsupported, OR (b) wire a periodic re-read in _scheduleNormalCadence that re-clamps via _clampCadence on each tick. Option (a) is the simpler V1 path. Test: add static-source assertion to ossSyncFallback.spec.js that _clampCadence is only called from _runtimeConfig (single-source-of-truth).
findings.blast_radius: low (no production observation of CDN-pushed config mutation today)

findings.title: No observability for sustained disconnect on production walls
findings.evidence: OssSyncService._maybeWarnDisconnect (lines 254-274) only fires console.warn in NON-PRODUCTION (line 261-264 explicit appEnv !== 'production' check). Production walls running in fallback-only mode for hours emit no telemetry. SRE has no signal to detect that a real WS infrastructure issue caused a fleet of walls to silently degrade.
findings.rationale_already_heal_or_new: NET-NEW gap (slightly — was implicit in agent-4-oss but not flagged as a P2 SRE concern). Not addressed in session-A.
findings.heal_recommendation: When OssSyncService disconnects for > 60s in production, emit a single beacon to a /api/admin/observability endpoint (existing Laravel route per V1.0.2 backlog). Bounded by one beacon per disconnect window (already have _devWarnedDisconnected guard). Defer V1.0.2.

findings.title: Echo subscription `eventContract.onEvents` lacks visible re-subscribe sentinel
findings.evidence: PreparingAndReadyComponent.vue:252-273 — _eventSub created via onEvents(branchId, [...]); unsubscribe wired in unsubscribeEcho() at line 279-289. eventContract.onEvents implementation owns reconnect logic. No test asserts re-subscription after a connection drop/reconnect storm. The wsState handler in OssSyncService (lines 191-199) fires _burstPoll on reconnect — that ensures the polling path catches up — but Echo channel re-subscription is implicit.
findings.rationale_already_heal_or_new: NET-NEW gap — discovered cross-referencing agent-4-oss §3 reconnect strategy.
findings.heal_recommendation: Add tests/js/ossEchoReconnect.spec.js (mirroring orderStatusScreenOssSync.spec.js static-source style) asserting onEvents/eventContract returns an unsubscribe handle AND PreparingAndReadyComponent.vue calls unsubscribe before re-subscribing on remount.

findings.title: AUDIT-P1 double-chime/flash de-dup guard works
findings.evidence: PreparingAndReadyComponent.vue:258-264 + 354-362 — _echoMarkedReady Set prevents double _markNewReady when list() refresh follows an Echo PREPARED event. Confirmed working in ossChimePublicWall.spec.js attestation suite.

verdict: AUDIT-ONLY pass. Wave 3c cadence clamp + 5xx backoff + abort-controller cleanup + visibility burst + wake-lock acquire/release are all sound. Two net-new P1/P2 SRE forward-looking gaps: (Z2-SRE-02 runtime-refresh clamp scope) and (Z2-SRE-03 production observability beacon). Both deferred V1.0.2 with backlog tickets.
